content.title: About
content.content: Sesame dressing, light is a low‑calorie sauce made from sesame paste, vegetable oils, vinegar and aromatic spices. It offers a gentle nutty flavor, moderate acidity, and reduced fat and sugar compared with the classic version, making it suitable for diet‑friendly meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sesame seeds, the main ingredient, have been cultivated in Asia for over 5,000 years.
The light version contains less oil and sugar than regular sesame dressing.
The sauce is commonly used in Asian cuisine to dress salads, rolls, and to marinate fish.
Sesame is rich in antioxidants such as sesamol and sesamin.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Sesame provides about 18 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Contains mono‑ and polyunsaturated fatty acids beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: Contains calcium and magnesium
items.content: May help strengthen bones and support normal nerve function.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Sesamol and sesamin help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The light dressing typically has around 70 kcal per 100 g, convenient for weight management.

items.title: Sesame allergy
items.content: Sesame is one of the top eight food allergens; reactions can be severe.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some varieties may contain added salt; people with hypertension should monitor intake.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Even the light version may contain small amounts of sugar, relevant for diabetics.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Sesame dressing, light works well as a dressing for green salads, vegetable mixes, sushi rolls, marinating chicken or tofu, and as a sauce for noodle dishes. It can also be blended into smoothies for a nutty note.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sauce in the refrigerator after opening, tightly sealed, and use within 30 days. Discard if the smell, color, or taste changes.
